configuration.boundary: resident state; persistent worker pool; steady-state
notes: The persistent pool owns prebuilt pointer tables and worker ranges.
The per-turn lane sends one command per turn and preserves synchronous publication.
The fused unchecked block sends one command for all measured turns and publishes only at the block boundary.
Compilation, input construction, process startup, warmup, and final state readback are outside the timed region.
